package.description: Drive a running Unity Editor from the terminal or from an AI agent.

en-US.description: Drive a running Unity Editor from the terminal or from an AI agent.
en-US.longDescription:
isuzu-unity-cli talks to a Unity Editor on the same machine that has the jp.shiranui-isuzu.unity-mcp package installed. It reads the console, compiles, runs tests, browses and edits the scene, and captures the Game and Scene views.
It can also send C# code to that Editor, which compiles and runs it with full access to the Editor API.
en-US.name: isuzu-unity-cli
